# netapp-storagegrid_grid_account (Resource)

Manages a tenant account of StorageGRID, with the Grid Management API.

StorageGRID can take 15 minutes or longer to apply the settings of a tenant account across the grid. A tenant account can only be deleted when all its S3 buckets and objects are removed: StorageGRID refuses otherwise, and Terraform shows its message. When the tenant account can use a grid federation connection, StorageGRID deletes it on all the grids of the connection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "tenant_root_password" {
  description = "Password of the root user of the tenant"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

resource "netapp-storagegrid_grid_account" "tenant" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "grid1"

  name         = "analytics"
  description  = "Tenant of the data analytics team"
  capabilities = ["management", "s3"]

  # the tenant manages its own groups and users
  use_account_identity_source = true
  allow_platform_services     = true

  # 10 GiB. Do not set the quota for no quota.
  quota_object_bytes = 10 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024

  # password of the root user of the tenant
  password = var.tenant_root_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `capabilities` (Set of String) Capabilities of the tenant account: `s3`, the object storage protocol (`swift` was removed in StorageGRID 12.0), and `management`, which users need to sign in to the Tenant Manager and to use the Tenant Management API, for example `["management", "s3"]`.
- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name. The profile must be a grid profile, without `account_id`.
- `name` (String) Name of the tenant account, for display. It does not have to be unique, as StorageGRID identifies the account with its ID. It can be changed.
- `use_account_identity_source` (Boolean) Whether the tenant uses its own identity source, and manages its own groups and users (`true`), or uses the identity source of the grid (`false`). StorageGRID does not accept `false` for a tenant that already configured its own identity source: the tenant has to disable it first.

### Optional

- `allow_compliance_mode` (Boolean) Whether the tenant can use the compliance mode for S3 Object Lock and retention. Requires StorageGRID 11.9 or later, and S3 Object Lock enabled on the grid. When it is not set, the value of StorageGRID is kept.
- `allow_platform_services` (Boolean) Whether the tenant can use the platform services, such as CloudMirror replication, notifications and search integration. Defaults to `false`.
- `allow_select_object_content` (Boolean) Whether the tenant can use the S3 SelectObjectContent API to filter and retrieve object data. Requires StorageGRID 11.6 or later. When it is not set, the value of StorageGRID is kept.
- `description` (String) Additional information that identifies the tenant account, such as an email address. It is not shown in the Tenant Manager.
- `grant_root_access_to_group` (String) Federated group of the grid that has the Root access permission in the tenant, in the format `federated-group/<name>`. The group must exist in the Grid Manager, and the tenant must use the identity source of the grid: `use_account_identity_source` is `false`. StorageGRID only uses it when the tenant account is created, and never returns it: it cannot be changed afterwards. To use another group, replace the account, or change the permissions of the groups of the tenant.
- `max_retention_days` (Number) Maximum retention period, in days, that is allowed for the new objects in compliance or governance mode. Requires StorageGRID 11.9 or later, and S3 Object Lock enabled on the grid. Setting it replaces a maximum retention period that is in years. When it is not set, the value of StorageGRID is kept.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the root user of the tenant, at least 8 characters. Set it, or `grant_root_access_to_group`, when the tenant account is created: nobody can sign in to the tenant otherwise. StorageGRID never returns the password: Terraform sets it when the tenant account is created, and sets it again when the value changes. It does not detect a password that was changed in StorageGRID, and removing it from the configuration does not change the password of the tenant.
- `quota_object_bytes` (Number) Quota of the tenant, in bytes. It is a logical amount, the size of the objects, and not the space that they use on disk. Do not set it for no quota.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the tenant account, assigned by StorageGRID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# A grid_account is imported with its ID, and the name of the connection profile: id,cx_profile_name
# StorageGRID never returns the password: it is not in the state after the import.
terraform import netapp-storagegrid_grid_account.tenant 12345678901234567890,grid1
```
